source_chain: The retained profiler-container libtorch_cuda artifact matches the existing production_source_identity exactly.
BF16 host caller 0x1deefa3 invokes the BF16/unsigned-index dispatcher at0x1eeff40.
Caller geometry at0x1deeaa1..0x1deeb4c: small grid=min(ceil(H/128),CU*32), block=min(H,128); large grid=min(ceil(N*H/128),CU*64), block=min(N*H,128).
Three canUse32BitIndexMath checks at0x1deeb72/0x1deeb87/0x1deeba1 guard output/source/indices; failure takes a different index-width dispatcher.
The exact libtorch_cpu implementation is retained in index_math_dispatch.json and bf16_launch_binding.json; it bounds numel and element-stride offsets, not observed row counts.
The BF16 dispatcher tests index count<=16 at0x1ef0542; larger counts select the large-index branch. No8192-row branch is present in the selected host program.

accepted_scope.operation: BF16 contiguous 2D table index_select(dim0), contiguous INT64 indices, fresh contiguous output
accepted_scope.known_source_extent: source_rows is the real table extent; rows is the selected count, not the table extent
accepted_scope.conservative_sufficient_32bit_domain: 2*source_rows*hidden<2^31 and2*rows*hidden<2^31 and8*rows<2^31; these byte bounds are stronger than the source element-offset checks
accepted_scope.legacy_observed_scope: Without explicit contiguous source extent, the existing1..8192-row observation-bound scope remains unchanged.
accepted_scope.sharded_embedding_extent: Unquantized vLLM0.24 TP2/no-added-vocabulary uses pad(global_vocab,64)/TP physical table rows from the same forward; the local shard is not padded again. Mask helper returns Long IDs; no additional ID conversion.

limitations: No GPU or provider correctness/timing validation
No change to physical rates or predictor mechanisms
Observed8192-row coverage is not a source launch cutoff
Native RoPE supplies the actual contiguous cache extent from the same virtual forward; storage and payload are unchanged
TP mask helper and mask-output fill are separate producers and do not inherit this index_select launch or acceptance.
